answer: Why can’t fake identities flood the system during peak epochs? At zenith load, agents must solve quartz-hashed puzzles with no cache—each solution burns real cycle time. The system tracks solution density, flagging farm attempts as compute spikes exceed per-agent baselines. Cost: linear CPU cycles per fake head, nocturnal thermal throttling enforces hardware limits. Like a fable where tricks backfire, more Sybils melt the hardware.
